title: "The Difference Between Love and Attachment"
description: A heartbroken young man seeks guidance from a calm spiritual elder, learning to distinguish the pain of attachment from the true nature of love over warm tea.
target_audience: Adults navigating heartbreak, relationship growth, self-discovery, and spiritual emotional maturity.
moral: True love heals through freedom and wholeness, whereas attachment causes pain by demanding another complete what is already within.
style: Cinematic digital manhwa art style, soft 3D cel-shaded realism, 4k resolution, delicate soft lighting, atmospheric indoor ambient light, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens, smooth subtle facial movement, high aesthetic detail

dialogue.speaker: Kael
dialogue.line: It hurts so much. Doesn't that mean I loved her?

dialogue.speaker: Elden
dialogue.line: Pain does not measure love's depth, Kael. It measures dependency.
